recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core-source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5832; any future work would be a separate historical-publication correction rather than a current-build fix.
issue_request: FHIR-5832 is a Published/Persuasive OO change request for DSTU1 asking to rename OrderResponse.code to OrderResponse.orderStatus because the element represented the status of the order being responded to.
initial_application: Jira says the change was preapplied. No exact historical commit tagged FHIR-5832 was found, but commit cd3cbf8d9d changed the OrderResponse spreadsheet and example from OrderResponse.code/code to OrderResponse.orderStatus/orderStatus; source/history.html also records the rename.
additional_context: FHIR-10059 later removed Order and OrderResponse because Task superseded them. Commit 16997a29 removed the OrderResponse source folder and active fhir.ini entries, and current fhir.ini lists OrderResponse only as a removed resource. The nearby historical commit label #5852 was checked and FHIR-5852 is an unrelated BodySite issue, so it appears to be a typo in the old SVN message.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current build no longer contains an OrderResponse resource to edit, residual retained references already use orderStatus or mark the resource as removed, and no OrderResponse.code occurrences remain in current source.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive OO issue that removed Order and OrderResponse as superseded by Task, explaining why the current build has no active OrderResponse source.
Already represented on the combined branch; its audit covers the broader Order/OrderResponse versus ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse reconciliation.

The historical rename commit mentions #5852, but the Jira snapshot shows FHIR-5852 is an unrelated BodySite issue, so this was treated as an old commit-message typo rather than a related OrderResponse decision.
